description: This file defines the 'Bot' data model and associated methods for managing bot entities in the Mattermost system, including validation, cloning, patching, and utility functions.

classes.name: Bot
classes.description: Represents a programmatic bot user in the system, with fields for identification, display, description, owner, and timestamps.

classes.name: BotPatch
classes.description: Specifies optional fields for updating an existing bot.

classes.name: BotGetOptions
classes.description: Provides filtering options for bulk fetching of bots.

classes.name: BotList
classes.description: A list of Bot pointers, representing multiple bot entities.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the bot's fields for auditing purposes.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Provides minimal info to identify a bot for logging.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the bot.

methods.name: IsValidCreate
methods.description: Validates the bot data for creation, checking username, display name, description, and owner ID.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the bot's overall integrity, including ID and timestamps.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the bot object before saving, setting timestamps and normalizing username.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates the timestamp before saving modifications.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Generates an etag string for caching based on user ID and update timestamp.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies optional updates to the bot's fields.

methods.name: WouldPatch
methods.description: Checks if a given patch would modify the bot.

methods.name: UserFromBot
methods.description: Creates a User model from a Bot instance.

methods.name: BotFromUser
methods.description: Creates a Bot model from a User instance.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Computes an etag for a list of bots.

methods.name: MakeBotNotFoundError
methods.description: Creates an error indicating a bot was not found or access is denied.

methods.name: IsBotDMChannel
methods.description: Determines if a channel is a direct message channel with a specific bot user ID.
